name: Rough Throwgrip
description: Skim the blade past the cuff of a sword arm so the cloth parts and the wrist is nicked.

name: Keen Weighttang
description: Throw into a standing board to learn how deep a point must bite to hold a hanging cloth.

name: Entangling Balanceblade
description: Drive a blade through a robe hem into the floor so the foe's step is caught and tripped.

name: Edgeflat Swerve
description: Shuffle the lead foot aside while drawing the knife so the body leaves the line before the throw.

name: Cramping Spinthrow
description: Drive a qi-sharpened blade through the sleeve and into a post so the striking arm is pinned fast.

name: Binding Pointguard
description: Throw two blades in quick succession through the same cloak at shoulder and hip to hold the foe against a wall.

name: Rough Bladeflat
description: Open a series with a lazy one-spin toss that draws the foe's eyes to the right hand.

name: Flightflog
description: Turn a half circle as the first knife leaves and bring the second hand ready for the next throw.

name: Slimscreen
description: Hold the elbow forward between throws so the arm covers the ribs from a close cut.

name: Prowling Throwtang
description: Swerve on the third spin of the run to leave the line of a counter-throw.

name: Lodge Scorer
description: Throw in a continuous wheel of motion at a target ring with each release timed to the circling arm.

name: Keen Spineweight
description: Throw four blades in a rolling chain where each spin carries the next so all land in one rising column.

name: Padded Edgeflat
description: Hold a circle of qi around the throwing arm between releases so a close cut is turned away.

name: Rugged Flight
description: Throw on the beat of the walking stride so the arm swing and step carry the knife together.

name: Rude Spinetip
description: Circle the target at a steady pace and release at the point where the arm faces it squarely.

name: Stick Stalk
description: Weave left and right in short steps then release on the center step to confuse an archer.

name: Slimslap
description: Skip forward on one foot and loose the knife at the top of the hop with the shoulders still.

name: Sound Bladeflat
description: Glance back once to read how far a pursuer has closed and pick the grip for the next throw.

name: Stickscorer
description: Pivot on the rear foot at the last moment and throw while the target expects the back to turn.

name: Lurching Thunk
description: Move in a widening spiral while loosing knives at steady intervals so the foe cannot hold a firm stance.

name: Brutal Pointguard
description: Leap with qi in the legs and throw at the peak of the jump so the blade falls hard on the mark.

name: Cometthunk
description: Glance over the shoulder and toss the knife backward past the ear at the pursuer's chest.

name: Sleet Flight
description: Swing the arm across the body from the far hip and send the blade at a foe on the flank.

name: Doughty Hiltweight
description: Throw from the rear heel while stepping backward so the blade leaves at the end of each pace.

name: Shard Balanceblade
description: Flip the knife with a loose wrist behind the back at a target that has crept to the blind side.

name: Brawn Throwtang
description: Roll low behind a barrel or sill while keeping the throwing hand free and the knives secure.

name: Pirouetting Lodge
description: Whirl a half turn in mid-run to face the pursuer and be set to throw again.

name: Shivbarrier
description: Throw low behind the running heel to pin a pursuer's trailing cloak or boot to the ground.

name: Draught Throwgrip
description: Throw over the shoulder with a curl of qi so the blade arcs round an obstacle to the pursuer.

name: Doughty Flickthrow
description: Scatter three blades low behind the body so a close pursuit slows to watch its footing.

name: Hum Spineweight
description: Flick a knife against a stretched cord and listen to the pitch to judge its tension.

name: Staticshiv
description: Hold the blade by the point and throw it edge-on so it meets the cord at a slicing angle.

name: Humshiv
description: Throw at the strap close to its buckle where the leather is thinnest and the cut is sure.

name: Gall Weighttang
description: Cut the cord of a hanging lamp above a foe so it falls and spills fire between you.

name: Shard Stick
description: Sever the rein of a passing rider with a fast flat throw from the roadside.

name: Stickswerve
description: Step out from under a cut rope as it falls so the weight does not catch the thrower.

name: Gall Spinetip
description: Cut an archer's drawn string with a short throw so the bow lashes back across the face.

name: Humthunk
description: Cut a snare net's main cord with a qi-edged blade so the whole net drops open.

name: Discord Flickthrow
description: Throw a heavy knife with a qi shove at a thin tether link so it parts and frees the line.

name: Slimbuckle
description: Send three small throws along one lashing so each strand frays and the bundle opens.

name: Cometlodge
description: Pull the first knife from the chest strap with a slanting hand so the blade is already turning.

name: Gap Bladeflat
description: Keep a mental count of the blades left in each loop so the thrower never reaches for an empty place.

name: Humlodge
description: Cross both arms to draw a blade with each hand and throw them outward at two foes.

name: Patient Hiltweight
description: Tilt the shoulder to settle the bandolier and slide the spent loop's blade back into reach.

name: Stickzip
description: Roll forward over the shoulder so the strap stays flat against the chest and no blade snags.

name: Purpose Pointguard
description: Draw and throw the whole top row of the bandolier in one sweeping motion to pin a foe's advance.

name: Comet Spinthrow
description: Press a pulse of qi into the last blade in the bandolier so it punches through light armor.

name: Sleetstick
description: Hold three blades between the fingers of one hand so they can leave in a spread one after another.

name: Emberlodge
description: Throw two blades with a slight outward turn so they land a hand apart on the foe's torso.

name: Brutal Edgeflat
description: Throw three blades with a wide arm sweep so they land across the foe's whole width.

name: Draught Spinetip
description: Wave the fanned blades in front of the face to knock away darts and low thrown stones.

name: Brawn Thunk
description: Step in under a foe's reach while the fan is still in hand and ready to loose.

name: Discord Flight
description: Throw the fan toward both of a foe's likely dodge directions so no easy step remains.

name: Cometstick
description: Throw four blades in one qi-guided fan so each takes its own course and lands in a tight spread.

name: Viselike Throwgrip
description: Throw the fan so its blades pin the foe's cloak and both sleeves against the wall behind.

name: Static Spinthrow
description: Throw at the top rim of a raised shield so the knock lifts the foe's guard a finger.

name: Shard Flickthrow
description: Hurl the knife flat into a held sword's side so the blade swings a hand off its line.

name: Hiltweight Swat
description: Throw a knife pommel-first at a guard's knuckles to jar the grip without cutting.

name: Lodgezip
description: Step toward the foe the moment the guard is knocked down and ready the next cut.

name: Sleet Balanceblade
description: Throw into the haft of a polearm near the foe's hand to swing the head wide.

name: Comet Spineweight
description: Spin a blade into the edge of a small round shield so it turns and exposes the arm behind.

name: Hum Throwtang
description: Hammer a qi-loaded blade into a raised shield's center to numb the arm that holds it.

name: Gripping Pointguard
description: Send two blades into the same guard a heartbeat apart so the second finds the opening the first made.

name: Dusklodge
description: Chain knocking throws at a foe's guard in rolling order so the blocking arm tires and sags.
